instruction: Calculate the sum of all values in the 'Old ID' column and write the result in cell E1.

The evaluator checks if cell E1 contains this value after the agent completes the task. Custom getter reads the Excel file and extracts the value from cell E1, custom metric compares it against the expected sum.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Full score (1.0) if cell E1 contains 68727.0 (within tolerance of 0.01), otherwise 0.0
